trusted_baseline.shape: E3/F012 live handoff plus delayed block3 consumption from existing Stage12 scratch

H1.reason: Every no-memory delayed-out3 form needs 24 F012 outputs plus eight independent block3 basis values, exceeding the 31 data registers available with q0 reserved.

H2.reason: Pair-major preserves arithmetic reuse but requires 96 raw-q reloads, violating the Track H hard gate.

H3.reason: One independent vector per stripe is required. Any complete register basis recreates the 32-data-vector versus 31-register deficit; a memory basis is no better than G1.

decision.reason: No H1/H2/H3 model passes the semantic, register, and memory hard gates. H0 also shows only two cycles of optimistic whole-path headroom.
decision.reopen_condition: Only revisit Track H with a materially different Phase123 representation or transform decomposition that changes the eight independent block3 dimensions or the q0/data-register contract.
